topic: Klein Vision AirCar Nitra to Bratislava
hook: Your car grows wings and flies to another city.
title: A Car That Grew Wings And Flew Cities
description:
In 2021, Klein Vision's AirCar flew from Nitra to Bratislava in Slovakia. Its wings fold out of the car body, then fold back so it can drive on the road. A real car, a real flight between two real cities.

#Shorts #AirCar #FlyingCar
comment_prompt: Would you fly to work in this? Yes or no

scenes.narration: Your car grows wings and flies.
scenes.headline: A CAR WITH WINGS

scenes.narration: It really happened in Slovakia in 2021.
scenes.headline: SLOVAKIA, 2021

scenes.narration: The AirCar drove onto a runway.
scenes.headline: DRIVES TO RUNWAY

scenes.narration: Then its wings folded out from the body.
scenes.headline: WINGS FOLD OUT

scenes.narration: It flew from Nitra to Bratislava.
scenes.headline: NITRA TO BRATISLAVA

scenes.narration: Two real cities, no traffic jam.
scenes.headline: NO TRAFFIC JAM

scenes.narration: It landed, folded its wings, and drove off.
scenes.headline: WINGS FOLD BACK

scenes.narration: Your car grows wings, and one already did.
scenes.headline: IT ALREADY DID
